title: Lignin Nanoparticle Lab: a population-balance model of lignin nanoparticle formation and breakup
description: Interactive, self-contained browser model (single HTML file, no dependencies) and Python reference implementation of lignin nanoparticle formation by antisolvent addition, dilute-H2SO4 acid precipitation and sonication. Sectional population balance with CNT nucleation, diffusion-limited growth, DLVO-limited aggregation, stress-based breakage and engulfment micromixing; outputs DLS-comparable Z-average and PDI. Solubility enters through openCOSMO-RS transfer free energies where supplied, with Hansen-parameter fallback and estimated properties for protic ionic liquids (flagged 'est'). Screening-level model: validate against DLS.
